summary: Shandong Guojing New Materials Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research and production of CVD precision ceramics, high-purity semiconductor quartz, and related compounds. Their products are integral to various sectors including semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and new energy vehicles, with a strong domestic market presence in pyrolytic boron nitride and graphite.
